verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduled jobs are a fair question for a commerce platform with agent tooling, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack documents no scheduler, cron, or recurring-workflow feature. Order webhooks are event-driven pushes, not a recurring schedule, and the CLI and MCP tools only run one-off actions that the agent itself invokes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
